about_short_description.short_description: AtoB is a technology company building payments infrastructure for the transportation industry.

product.name: AtoB Fuel Cards
product.description: Fleet fuel cards that provide discounts on fuel purchases and include security controls to manage and monitor fleet fuel expenses.

product.name: Driver Pay
product.description: A payment service that enables instant payments to drivers, including payroll processing and tax automation.

product.name: AtoB Discount Network
product.description: A network offering discounts on fuel and vehicle-related services at over 30,000 gas stations and service providers nationwide.

product.name: Telematics Integration
product.description: Integration with telematics systems to monitor vehicle location and fuel usage, enhancing security and preventing unauthorized fuel purchases.

product.name: AtoB FuelMap
product.description: A route planning tool that identifies the cheapest fuel stations along a driver’s route to optimize fuel costs.
